verdict.rationale: telli documents an agent builder with a Test call dialog (draft or saved revisions) and recording/transcript review, an AI assistant (Charlie) that builds agents, and custom voices via voice cloning. Phone-number setup is documented mainly as forwarding to a telli number or importing your own SIP trunk number, so the number step depends on carrier/PBX configuration. Nothing evidences how quickly the first live call can happen. Missing for 10: evidence of a sub-hour time-to-first-call, documentation of prompt authoring, a self-serve flow to provision a new number, hands-on or independent corroboration of an end-to-end quickstart.
